title: Logo on yellow
description: Use only above a yellow hero (HRO-01 to HRO-03) so the band reads as one block.
usage: Header that bleeds into a yellow hero. MyFreeStyle lockup on brand yellow. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Locked. White butterfly + charcoal type on a #FFD100 16px-rounded tile (invisible on the yellow band).
Locked. Figma's dark-instance vector on the same #FFD100 tile, shown on #5B4A00 via mfs-dark-img.

notes: Both logos carry the yellow tile, so even without the swap (clients that darken the band but ignore mfs-dark-img) the logo still sits on brand yellow.
Figma's mobile dark tile uses an 8px radius vs 16px on desktop; the image uses 16px at both sizes.
